LESSON MENU
Let's begin the lesson on RESISTANCE MEASUREMENTS.
Throughout this lesson, you will use resistance measurements to determine the operating condition of circuits.
For example, if the resistance measurement is zero, you can be sure the circuit is not working.
Resistance measurements indicate a lot about the operation of a circuit.
A multimeter can be used to measure resistance in a circuit.
